breeze.name: Breeze
breeze.note: Crab Breeze's own, built in Mining Mike's boss style. Recommended.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.note: Mining Mike's Uber mech, ported. Its back cradle now holds the jets.
bulwark.weapons: slab shield and siege fist (L), breaker cannon (R)

foreman.cockpit: wall: seated in a flat screen wall, in the cab
foreman.legs: digitigrade, three segments, double hydraulic rams, track-pad feet
foreman.name: Foreman
foreman.note: Original, after an excavator: slewing ring, roll cage, beacons, counterweight. Recommended.
foreman.opening: the bar grille lifts on two rams, the armour shutter drops into the belly

ironhorse.cockpit: jockey: leaning forward in the boiler
ironhorse.legs: digitigrade, drive-wheel knees with coupling rods, cow-catcher shins
ironhorse.name: Ironhorse
ironhorse.note: Original, after a steam locomotive: boiler chest, smokestack, dome, headlamp, tender.
ironhorse.opening: the dogs swing off, the round smokebox door swings open

ravager.cockpit: low head, visor under three eyes
ravager.name: Ravager
ravager.note: Mining Mike's rival Uber mech, ported. Hunched, a crest of blades.

stevedore.cockpit: harness: standing in a container chest
stevedore.name: Stevedore
stevedore.note: Original, after a dock crane: gantry, counter-jib and weights, warning lamps.
stevedore.opening: the four lock rods turn out, the container doors swing wide
stevedore.weapons: cargo mortar (L), crane jib with a harpoon grapple (R)
